description: Turns an audio file into a transcript the forest can search, through any OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint.

language.description: BCP-47 hint for the transcriber (pt, en, es). Empty lets it detect.

vocabulary.description: Names, jargon and acronyms the recording uses, comma separated. Spelling the transcriber cannot guess.

heading.description: The heading the transcript is written under.
